mechanism.classical_control: same state preparation and parameter shapes; classical readout uses only Re(z) and disables the Im(z) gate channel
mechanism.default_score_policy: base attention fixed; value route only
mechanism.state_preparation: data-dependent RY/RZ rotations followed by a nearest-neighbour CNOT ring from |0...0>
mechanism.value_route: g R1(v) + (1-g) R0(v) or g v
